title: Doctors and Medical Experts required for AI research Projects (open/rolling applications) - US
description:
We are looking for doctors and medical experts to join our growing community of experts who are available to be matched on an on-going basis to new innovative AI projects with the world's leading AI labs and companies that are bringing to life AI in healthcare.

 

Your medical expertise will shape the way AI understands and processes real-world clinical interactions, workflows, consultations including the delivery of care with software that directly impacts both healthcare professionals and patients.

 

These projects are flexible, fully remote and ideal for clinicians who want to work on shaping the future of AI in healthcare alongside their existing professional or academic commitments.

 

ABOUT MENTIS AI

 

At Mentis AI, we’re building the next generation of AI systems grounded in real-world clinical expertise. As a clinical expert, you’ll gain hands-on exposure to cutting-edge AI model development, working side-by-side with senior AI researchers and clinicians to translate your medical knowledge into industry-ready clinical solutions to advance healthcare.

 

HOW IT WORKS

 

Once we have a new project, you will be automatically screened and matched to assess if you are a suitable fit. If shortlisted, we will then invite you to take a skills test (~10-30mins) and if required will also conduct an interview.

 

We are looking to match you based on your skillset, expertise, grade and speciality to make sure it's the right fit for the project!

 

If successful, you will be onboarded onto the platform and can start getting involved in a diverse range of tasks that vary from labelling clinical notes, summarising medical records, annotating images to reviewing and evaluating the performance of AI Models/LLMs.

 

The rapid rise of AI in healthcare means there are so many new and exciting ways to train, review and improve the deployment of AI in healthcare, which you will directly have an impact upon.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 

- Data labeling and curation: Review clinical notes, audio, videos and other modalities, identifying relations and reasoning steps per guidelines.

- LLM and model evaluations: Run structured evals (human-in-the-loop) to assess accuracy, safety, clinical relevance and clinical reasoning of models.

- Prompting and prompt-engineering: Design, test, and iterate prompts to improve performance and reliability.

- Fine-tuning support: Create high-quality instructions/responses and explore edge-case datasets to enhance models.

- Feedback and error analysis: Identify critical/failure points, propose strategies to help mediate and document findings.

- Scoring/Rubrics frameworks: Develop and refine scoring rubrics for quality assurance (e.g., accuracy, clarity, safety, completeness, guideline adherence).

- Guideline refinement: Collaborate with researchers to improve annotation standards, acceptance criteria, and evaluation protocols.

 

ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS

 

- Doctor based in the US with active license to practice.

- Native or near-native fluency in English (spoken and written).

- Good understanding of clinical terminology, tools and workflows.

- Excellent summarisation and written communication skills.

- Strong attention to detail and commitment to clinical accuracy.

- Comfortable working independently in an asynchronous environment.

 

WHAT WE OFFER

 

- Remote work

- Asynchronous and flexible scheduling, allowing you to balance work with clinical practice or studies.

- Competitive compensation based on experience.

- The opportunity to influence and enhance AI tools that serve healthcare professionals.

- Experience working at the intersection of medicine and AI, helping shape the future of healthcare.

- Opportunity to collaborate with clinicians and AI researchers to deepen your own clinical acumen and professional expertise in AI within healthcare.

title: Staff ML Engineer, Perception Research
locationText: Mountain View, CA, USA ; New York City +6 more
description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver-The World's Most Experienced Driver™-to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

The mission of the Waymo AI Foundations team is to develop machine learning solutions addressing open problems in autonomous driving, towards the goal of safely operating Waymo vehicles in dozens of cities and under all driving conditions. As part of our work, we also initiate and foster collaborations with other research teams in Alphabet. AI Foundations areas that we are currently focusing on include reinforcement learning, learning from demonstration, generative modeling, Bayesian inference, hierarchical learning, and robust evaluation.

This role follows a hybrid work schedule and reports to a Principal Research Scientist.

You will :

• Conduct comprehensive experimentation to train and deploy state-of-the-art Multimodal LLMs and World models to perform 3D Perception using sensor information from Camera, LiDAR and Radar..

• Partner effectively with engineering and research teams across Waymo to deploy new models, and implement efficient workflows for model development and continuous training on new front-filled data.

• Apply and develop techniques such as quantization, pruning, knowledge distillation, and efficient attention mechanisms.

• Develop and maintain scalable data pipelines for Training & Eval to process data from multiple sources.

• Design and implement evaluation frameworks for perception models.

• Develop infrastructure for large-scale model distillation and bulk-inference pipelines for teacher models.

• Experiment with different model partitioning and sharding strategies to improve scalability and efficiency.

• Build and maintain tools for performance analysis, profiling (e.g., xprof), and debugging of ML models.

You have:

• PhD or Masters in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Robotics, or a similar technical field, with 4+ years of industry or post-doc research experience in Reinforcement Learning or Foundation Models. 

• Proficiency in implementing model training flows in a scalable, distributed and performant manner such as Data parallel, FSDP and other sharding approaches. 

• Proficiency in JAX, Flax, and potentially TensorFlow/PyTorch.

• A willingness to work with complexity of globally distributed inference infrastructure.

• Hands on experience with optimizing the training and inference of Transformer architectures

We prefer:

• PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or Robotics, with a research focus on Reinforcement Learning, Foundation Models, or Multi-Modal learning.

• Substantial involvement in and contributions to high impact industry AI projects.

• Experience in generative models for domains such as world models, images, videos, 3D, using techniques such as diffusion or autoregressive models.

• Experience contributing to frameworks and libraries that improve training speed and scalability (e.g., JAX, Gemax, XManager)

title: Creative Director (Marketing)
description:
Not all heroes wear capes - but plenty of them use toilet paper

Want to challenge yourself at a purpose-led scale up AND make a difference in the world? Come join the revolootion!

Funny name, serious business

We are a leading eco-friendly household essentials business and we donate 50% of our profits to help everyone gain access to clean water and a toilet. As of June 2026, we’ve contributed over $20 million AUD to this mission. Basically, we’re really good at making it easy to do good.

We’re scaling our business across the UK, US, Australia and Canada, with our amazing team spread across these markets. Our 250+ people aim to make the biggest possible impact for people and the planet. Over the next 5-10 years, we’re hoping to increase our annual donation tenfold to get us closer to our dream of everyone in the world having access to clean water and sanitation services.

A bit about the role

We’re looking for a Creative Director to lead our Marketing Design team (the people behind our limited editions, brand campaigns, social, lifecycle and promotions). You’ll set the creative bar across two quite different worlds: the big, ambitious brand storytelling that makes people fall for us, and the fast creative work, informed by data, that keeps our growth engine humming. You’ll lead two senior designer/art directors directly, and a wider team of makers day to day, coaching them to do the best work of their careers while keeping plenty of moving parts on track. Expect to spend around 70% of your time on creative direction and 30% hands-on, stepping into the work yourself during big campaign moments.

If you worked here this past month here are some things you might have been involved in:

• Led a limited edition from concept through packaging development to full campaign rollout 

• Steered the social team toward content that’s culturally sharp, fun and unmistakably on-brand

• Pushed the lifecycle team to create emails people actually want to open

• Overseen a high-growth promotion from creative concept to launch

• Coached your two senior designer/art directors through a tricky brief or a bit of creative friction

Let’s talk about you

You’ve led both sides of the coin

You’ve genuinely led both brand storytelling and growth-led creative. Or, you’ve led one and have real curiosity about the other. You know these two worlds need different thinking, different pace and different leadership, and you can flex between them without losing the plot.

You’re organised, not just talented

Big ideas are the baseline here, but so is a genuinely high level of self-motivation, proactivity and organisation. If you thrive only with a lot of structure built around you, this probably isn’t your role, but if you can bring your own structure to ambiguity, you’ll do well.

You’re a self-starter with real creative ambition

You’re fast-paced, comfortable with a bit of chaos and you have the energy to see your ideas through to the finish line (and to bring your team along with you while you do it).

You give a crap. Do you want your work to make the world a better place? Do you want to work with other people who feel the same way? What a coincidence, us too!

Why should you work with us?

First off, as a certified B Corp™, we work to make a difference every day while maintaining the high standards of social and environmental impact. We’re in very good company with other exceptional B Corps around the world.

We also believe that helping to make the world a better place should be rewarded accordingly - that’s why we offer competitive, market informed salaries, meaningful support towards healthcare for our team around the world, generous paid leave, tailored learning and development opportunities, and free toilet paper (yes, you read that right).

title: Associate Board Member, Hunger Free America
description:
About Hunger Free America :

Hunger Free America (HFA), founded in 1983 as the New York City Coalition Against Hunger, is a dynamic and highly effective national anti-hunger advocacy and direct service organization that is based in New York City but works in all 50 states. The Nation has written that the organization has grown into “one of the leading direct service and advocacy organizations on hunger and poverty in the nation.” Our mission is to build a nonpartisan, grassroots movement to enact the public policies and programs needed to end domestic hunger and ensure that all Americans have sufficient access to nutritious food.
Our long-term goal is not just to ameliorate the problem, but also to build the people’s movement necessary to enact the economic and public policies needed to end hunger entirely. Given that hunger drains our economy and tears at our moral and civic fabric, we know that eliminating it will boost the nation both economically and spiritually. Towards that end, we have adopted the motto: “Ending hunger lifts us all.”
About the Associate Board:
HFA is seeking dedicated and qualified candidates who are passionate about ending hunger in the U.S. to serve on our Associate Board. As an associate board member, you will play a vital role in supporting our organization’s efforts through organizing and hosting fundraising events, elevating the profile of HFA’s work, and by actively participating in learning opportunities related to nonprofit development.
This is an exciting opportunity for an early or mid-career professional to make a significant impact on the lives of vulnerable individuals and families experiencing hunger nationwide. The Associate Board will work in partnership with our Board of Directors.

Volunteer role: This is an unpaid, volunteer position without any financial compensation or benefits.
Responsibilities & Expectations:

•
Term:  Associate board positions are held for one, two-year term with the option for an extension based on forthcoming governance by-laws.

•
Fundraising Events:  Collaborate with the Development Team and staff to plan, organize, and execute fundraising events throughout the year aimed at generating funds for HFA’s programs. Utilize creativity and innovation to attract donors, sponsors, and community participants.

•
Donor Cultivation : Assist in identifying potential donors and sponsors for events, programs, and ongoing support. Contribute to nurturing relationships with donors and supporters in collaboration with the Development Department.

•
Networking and Outreach:  Engage with community leaders, local businesses, and other potential partners to build awareness of HFA's mission and expand the network of supporters.

•
Committee Participation:  Contribute actively to committees/working groups focused on specific initiatives, such as governance, event planning, marketing, volunteer recruitment, or strategic planning.

•
Advocacy and Awareness:  Support the organization's advocacy efforts by sharing information about food insecurity issues and the importance of anti-hunger initiatives on social media and within personal networks.

•
Financial Contributions:  Associate board members have a $500 a year give/get.

•
Board Meetings and Participation:  Attend quarterly board and committee meetings regularly and actively participate in discussions and decision-making processes. 

•
Nonprofit Development:  Enthusiasm for learning about nonprofit development, management, and governance. Stay informed about best practices and industry trends, and bring new ideas and insights to the board to enhance the HFA's effectiveness.

Qualifications:

• Strong passion for addressing hunger and food insecurity issues in New York City and nationwide.

title: Customer Success Specialist
description:
Customers rarely leave because of one big failure. They leave because nobody noticed the small ones. Your job is to notice.
Job Overview
Our UK-based client is hiring a Customer Success Specialist to own the health of their client relationships after the sale. This is a full-time, fully remote position for a South African professional who combines warmth with commercial awareness. You will onboard new customers, keep existing ones engaged and successful, and turn quiet accounts into loyal, growing ones.
About Our Client
Our client is a well-established UK business whose growth depends on customers staying, renewing and recommending. They have invested heavily in winning clients and now want the same discipline applied to keeping them. You will join a supportive team where customer success is treated as a revenue function, not a complaints desk.
Key Responsibilities

• Onboard new customers with structured welcome journeys that get them to value quickly

• Monitor account health and usage, spotting risks and reaching out before problems escalate

• Handle queries and issues end-to-end, coordinating internally until resolution is confirmed

• Run regular check-ins and reviews that surface feedback, wins and expansion opportunities

• Maintain accurate CRM records so the whole business sees the true state of every account

• Feed customer insights back to product, sales and leadership to improve the offer

What You Will Be Doing Day-to-Day
Your days blend proactive and reactive work. You will welcome new customers, walk them through their first weeks, and check on accounts that have gone quiet. When an issue lands in your inbox you own it: acknowledging fast, chasing the right people internally, and closing the loop properly. You will prepare simple health reports, flag renewal risks early, and celebrate customer wins loudly enough that the whole team hears them.
If you are a people-focused professional based in South Africa who gets real satisfaction from customers succeeding, this is a long-term remote role with an employer who values retention as much as acquisition.
Requirements

• 3+ years' experience in customer success, account management or client-facing support

• Excellent written and spoken English with a warm, professional communication style

• Confident with tech tools: CRMs, helpdesk platforms, spreadsheets and video calls

• Proven reliability: stable fibre internet, backup power for load shedding, and a quiet home office

• Strong organisation and follow-through, with the ability to juggle multiple accounts calmly

• A commercially aware mindset that spots retention risks and growth opportunities early

Benefits
Full-time remote position working for a UK-based employer. Competitive salary paid in ZAR. Long-term stable role. Supportive team environment. Direct access to founder-led business.

title: Senior Manager, Engineering - Identity & Access Management
description:
At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. 🚀

Come lead the Identity & Access Management Platform team (IAM Platform) - the foundational layer that decides who can see and do what across all of ClickUp. This team owns the authorization engine, the permission and role model, authentication (SSO, MFA, SCIM, OIDC), sharing primitives, audit logs, and the core data model and APIs that define how customers' work is organized and nested across the product - the foundation every other part of ClickUp is built on. It is backend-heavy, high-blast-radius work. As we move upmarket, this is some of the most important and security-sensitive work we do - enterprises decide whether they can trust us based on how precise, predictable, auditable, and manageable our access controls are.

 

We're looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead and grow this team. Your mandate is twofold: deliver an enterprise-grade access management platform - extensible, configuration-driven, correct and auditable by design - and build the team that will carry it, hiring and developing engineers as we invest heavily in enterprise. You'll raise the access, identity, and admin capabilities enterprises depend on to an enterprise-grade standard and keep them there, partnering with a Staff engineer on technical direction while you own delivery, people, and priorities.

 

Just as important: you'll run this team the way ClickUp runs - AI-native. We structure work so AI agents can read it, route it, roll it up, and report on it, so a small team amplified by agents operates at a different scale. There are no status-reporting meetings; agents keep status, progress, and health current from real signals, and reporting is self-serve. We want a manager who has already used AI flows to cut noise, eliminate busywork, and streamline how a team operates - and who will push that further.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

 

- Lead, grow, and develop the IAM Platform engineering team - own hiring, mentorship, performance, and career growth, and scale the team thoughtfully as we expand our enterprise investment.

- Own the delivery of ClickUp's enterprise-grade access management platform: the authorization engine and permission/role model, authentication (SSO via SAML/OIDC and social/Okta/Entra, MFA/2FA, session and token management), SCIM provisioning, sharing and access-control primitives, audit logs, OAuth and API token management, and the core data model and APIs that define how customers' work is organized across the product.

- Set the roadmap and priorities in partnership with product, security, and engineering leadership - elevating the access, identity, and admin capabilities enterprises depend on to an enterprise-grade standard and keeping them there.

- Run an AI-native team: structure the work so agents can route, scope, and report on it; use AI flows to remove status meetings and manual reporting, reduce noise, and let a small team operate at scale. Continuously raise the bar on how the team leverages AI end-to-end.

- Partner with enterprise customers, GTM, and security teams on access-control and identity requirements, and represent ClickUp credibly in enterprise security and architecture reviews.

- Own operational excellence for high-blast-radius services: a healthy on-call rotation, safe migrations, reliability, and a clear security boundary where the server remains the source of truth.

- Uphold a high engineering bar - design and code review, testing, performance, and security-by-design - for the most security-critical area of the product.

- Collaborate across backend, frontend, platform, product, design, and infosec to ship coherent access experiences

title: Staff Product Manager, Telephony
description:
ABOUT LIVEKIT

LiveKit is building the infrastructure layer for the voice-driven era of computing. Our platform gives developers everything they need to build, test, deploy, scale, and observe agents in production. Founded in 2021, LiveKit powers voice AI applications for OpenAI, xAI, Salesforce, Coursera, Spotify, and thousands of others, collectively facilitating billions of calls each year.

ABOUT THIS ROLE

We're looking for the first Product Manager for LiveKit Telephony: how AI agents utilize the global phone network. Landlines, mobile networks, and enterprise phone systems already connect nearly every person and business on earth. Making an agent a first-class participant on that network is what turns voice AI from a demo into something that picks up a real phone number and does real work.

Our PM team is small and high-leverage, with each PM coming in to establish the foundations in a new area of the business. Telephony is essential to many of the highest-value voice AI use cases running today: call centers, customer support, healthcare triage, outbound sales, appointment scheduling. A large share of our growth comes from enterprises putting agents on the phone at massive volume, and every one of those calls runs through this product.

You'll shape the direction and roadmap for Telephony alongside the engineering leaders who build it, across both sides of the product. On one side is SIP trunking, where enterprises bring the carriers and phone systems they already have and everything has to interoperate, stay up, and sound good. On the other is LiveKit Phone Numbers, our native offering, where we own the carrier relationships and hand a developer a working number in a couple of clicks. Going native lets us control the whole path a call takes, which means fewer hops, better audio, and quality we can actually tune. We intend to offer the fastest and best sounding connection an agent can get, anywhere in the world, and you'll decide how quickly we get there and how far the footprint reaches.

This role can be based remotely or in our SF HQ, where you'll be part of a collaborative in-office culture!

YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF YOU:

- are obsessed with making the best product for our customers

- are known as the go-to person for tackling tough problems

- work hard and can build and ship fast

- are focused on polish, detail, and quality

- are a fast learner, frequently picking up new tips, tricks, and skills

The best way to impress us is by trying LiveKit's product, understanding the space, and bringing smart thoughts and opinions to the table.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own the telephony roadmap. Build a clear point of view on where the product is going, and decide what gets built and when, in partnership with engineering.

- Meet enterprises where they are. SIP has as many interpretations as there are vendors. Decide what compatibility we take on, and when, so connecting an existing carrier, PBX, or contact center platform is straightforward instead of a project.

- Take native telephony global. Extend LiveKit Phone Numbers well beyond its US starting point, with the country coverage and regulatory footing to make buying a number from us the obvious choice.

- Get deep with customers and data. Understand how teams actually run phone-based agents in production, from the first trunk they configure to the calls that go wrong, and let that shape priorities.

- Own the economics. Telephony is already a meaningful business with real carrier costs behind it. Own pricing, packaging, and margin as volume grows and our footprint expands.

WHO YOU ARE

- 8+ years in product management, at a senior or staff level, with substantial experience managing a developer-facing products in particular.

- Technical depth. You can reason about protocols, media paths, latency, call quality, and failure modes, and earn the trust of strong engineers. You don't need to write code, but you need to understand systems well enough to make good tradeoffs.

title: Founding Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
FOUNDING FORWARD DEPLOYED ENGINEER

New York City · In Person · Travel Required

ABOUT FRONTDESK

Frontdesk is building AI workers that run customer operations across voice, text, email, and chat.

Over the last year, the size of the contracts we've been closing has increased roughly 10x, with several enterprise deals now reaching six figures and beyond.

At that scale, deployment stops being simple.

Our largest customers need custom integrations, complex workflows, outbound orchestration, legacy systems connected, and dozens of edge cases handled before AI can actually run meaningful parts of their business.

We're looking for the person who wants to own that problem.

THE ROLE

We're hiring our Founding Forward Deployed Engineer.

You will take our hardest enterprise customers from:

"We want Frontdesk to do this" → "It's live in production."

There won't always be a playbook.

You might fly to a customer's office, sit with their operators, understand a workflow nobody has documented properly, design the solution, and then build the missing integration or product capability yourself.

You won't throw requirements over the wall to another team. You'll work directly in the codebase and own the outcome.

And once it works, you'll ask the most important question:

How do we make sure we never have to build this from scratch again?

You'll take what you learn in the field and turn it into reusable Frontdesk product, infrastructure, and deployment primitives.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own our largest and most technically difficult enterprise deployments.

- Work directly with customers to understand how their businesses actually operate.

- Build integrations, workflows, internal tooling, and product capabilities needed to get them live.

- Travel onsite when being in the room helps us solve the problem faster.

- Work across voice, SMS, email, chat, APIs, data, LLMs, and workflow orchestration.

- Debug whatever is blocking a deployment, even when the problem sits outside Frontdesk.

- Identify patterns across customers and turn one-off solutions into scalable product.

- Work closely with the founders and engineering team on what Frontdesk should build next.

THIS IS A FOUNDING ROLE

We expect this to become a major function inside Frontdesk.

At first, you'll be extremely hands-on. You'll write code, work with customers, and personally own deployments.

As we scale, we expect you to build and eventually lead the Forward Deployed Engineering organization.

That means defining how we deploy enterprise AI, hiring the team, building the playbooks, and determining how Forward Deployed Engineering works with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success.

We're looking for someone who doesn't just want a job.

We're looking for someone who wants to build something from zero, own a massive surface area, and eventually lead the organization they create.

YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU

- Are a strong software engineer who wants more ownership than a traditional engineering role provides.

- Love talking to customers and solving real problems, not just working from tickets.

- Are comfortable jumping across the stack and learning whatever is necessary.

- Have strong product intuition and naturally think about how to generalize what you build.

- Thrive when the problem is ambiguous and there is no existing playbook.

- Move extremely quickly and take personal ownership over outcomes.

- Would rather own an entire problem than a small piece of a large system.

- Could see yourself founding a company someday, or already think like a founder.

title: Protocol Engineer
description:
Rockstar is recruiting for a foundation dedicated to supporting the growth, decentralization, and sustainability of a leading decentralized finance protocol. This client is committed to driving value in key focus areas such as Protocol and Innovation, Developers, Governance, Research, and Security through strategic grant-making.
The foundation is seeking a Protocol Engineer to join their technical team and contribute to the development of smart contracts for in-house projects, the protocol, Unichain, and grantee collaborations.
As a Protocol Engineer, the candidate will play a key role in designing, implementing, and optimizing smart contract systems. The role involves participating in technical design discussions, weighing trade-offs between optimization, flexibility, and integration, while also providing design feedback for ecosystem participants such as hook developers and Unichain DeFi projects.
What the Candidate Will Do:

• Design, implement, and optimize Solidity-based smart contracts for projects related to the protocol, focusing on security, efficiency, and maintainability.

• Provide technical guidance and design feedback for external developers building on the protocol and Unichain, including hook developers and DeFi projects.

• Explore and prototype new DeFi primitives, trading mechanisms, and smart contract architectures to expand the protocol’s capabilities.

• Participate in design sessions and code reviews, ensuring high standards in code quality, security, and organization.

• Implement unit tests, fuzz testing, and gas optimizations to ensure smart contract reliability and performance.

As a Protocol Engineer, the candidate may work on:

• Hooks and reference implementations for the protocol's latest version

- Experimental swapping UX designs

• Indexers and graph traversal algorithms

- Composable DeFi legos
- SDK abstractions and developer tooling

• Periphery integrations such as liquidity management tools and swap-and-add functionalities

What the Candidate Brings to the Table:
Required Skills & Experience:

• Strong understanding of DeFi patterns and smart contract architecture

• At least two years of experience writing complex Solidity smart contracts with an emphasis on readability, maintainability, and security

• Proficiency with Foundry, including cheatcodes, foundry.toml, and script execution

• Experience with unit testing and fuzz testing for smart contract security

• Confidence using Git and managing version control in a collaborative engineering environment

• Ability to design clean abstractions and reusable smart contract components

• Familiarity with the protocol's latest version contracts and related DeFi protocols

Nice to Haves:

• Experience with Yul and low-level opcodes for gas-efficient smart contract development

• Knowledge of gas optimization techniques

• Experience with invariant testing for smart contract correctness

• Public speaking experience for developer outreach and technical presentations

• Familiarity with TypeScript for SDK and front-end integrations

About the Foundation:
In pursuit of a more open and fair financial system, the foundation supports the growth, decentralization, and sustainability of the community. Through grants, they are driving value in five key focus areas: Protocol and Innovation, Developers, Governance, Research, and Security. Their grant-making approach is designed to maximize positive impact, bringing in new contributors to the community who focus on building new initiatives, committees, products, infrastructure, and more. To learn more about their community impact, visit their website.

title: Senior Director, Awareness to Revenue
description:
Senior Director, Awareness to Revenue
A2R Value Stream Owner / Awareness to Revenue Value Stream
About the role
The Senior Director, Awareness to Revenue serves as the A2R Value Stream Owner in Blackbaud ’s operating model, owning the end-to-end flow that converts market demand into recognized revenue across five connected motions: Demand to Lead, Lead Qualification, Seller, Pricing & Packaging, and Closed Revenue. Operating within a SAFe agile environment, this leader is accountable for the health and performance of the A2R stream as a system, defining the strategy, roadmap, and priorities that improve how work flows across the value stream.
This role does not manage the individual motions - the motions are run by their teams, guided by Experience Managers who own each motion’s feature backlog. Instead, it ensures the motions work together effectively by determining what work enters the stream, how it is sequenced, and where investments and improvements will have the greatest impact.
Shared Accountability for Revenue Performance. The revenue number is a shared objective, owned jointly with the Chief Commercial Officer and Chief Financial Officer , who sponsor the stream. They own the operational KPIs; this role owns the leading indicators that shift them - yield, conversion at each handoff, flow time - and is accountable for identifying and moving the right levers. When the number misses, the Chief Commercial Officer answers for whether we pursued the right demand at the right price; the Chief Financial Officer answers for whether the economics and controls held; and this role answers for whether the stream converted the demand it was given at the rate a healthy system should. None of the three can hit the number without the others.
A connected leadership model. This role is deliberately paired with the GTM Transformation Leader , a peer role reporting to the Chief Commercial Officer that owns the future state of Sales and Marketing and the AI-native business case behind it. The pairing works on one rule: the Transformation Leader writes the requirements; this role writes the sequence. The Transformation Leader role is currently open and being filled deliberately. AI-native redesign is the primary lever for improving the speed, effectiveness, and economics of the end-to-end revenue process.
What You’ll Do

Own the Flow

• Own the stream’s improvement strategy and roadmap, including the outcomes to advance and the sequence of changes needed to achieve them.

• Own the demand model from initial interest through closed revenue, including stage definitions, conversion points, and handoffs across the five motions.

• Own the stream’s business data taxonomy, including funnel stages, campaign naming, and attribution, so performance can be measured consistently across underlying systems and within the enterprise data architecture.

• Identify and remove structural bottlenecks across the end-to-end revenue process, addressing points where demand stalls, leaks, or requires manual intervention.

Lead AI-Native Redesign as the Primary Lever

• Redesign workflows using AI-native approaches, including agents, orchestration, automation, and human oversight, across the five motions. Partner across business, technology, and AI teams to identify scalable solutions that improve efficiency, increase adoption, and drive measurable business outcomes.

• Guide initiatives from proof of concept through enterprise deployment, measuring success through adoption and business value, not deployment alone.

• Set autonomy levels and human-oversight standards for the stream’s agentic workflows, applying the enterprise standards established by Data & AI Governance and deciding within them.

Own Intake, Portfolio & Governance

• Serve as the single point of intake for work entering the A2R stream: single-team work routes to the motion’s Experience Manager feature backlog; cross-cutting work enters the stream backlog this role owns.

• Chair the stream’s Busi

• Contributing to the development of high-quality safeguarding practice across Adult Social Care services.

description:
The Opportunity
Ulteig is seeking highly skilled and motivated Studies Engineers to support power system studies in the renewable energy markets. This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the advancement of renewable energy solutions through rigorous analysis and innovative engineering practices.
What You’ll Do
As a Studies Engineer, you will lead advanced power system analysis in the renewable energy sector. You’ll manage complex studies-such as TOV, TRV, AC interference, 5mA, insulation coordination, and EMF-using tools like PSCAD, Polaris, CDEGS, ASPEN Line Constants, and TLW-GEN. Your expertise will drive smarter, safer, and more efficient energy solutions.
Key Responsibilities:

• Conduct high-level system studies to support renewable energy projects.

• Apply specialized software to model and analyze electrical phenomena.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to interpret results and recommend solutions.

• Ensure technical accuracy and compliance with industry standards.

• Mentor junior engineers and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.

• Develop procedures for new study areas and support business development.

• Serve as technical lead on projects, coordinating with internal teams, external partners, and clients.

• Conduct technical reviews and enforce quality control standards.

• Research new technologies and contribute to process improvements.

• Participate in client meetings, present technical information, and support proposal development.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering (ABET-accredited or equivalent).

• Have or working towards a PE or P.Eng. license, required.

• A minimum of 4 years of working experience, with at least 3 years of experience directly related to power systems.

• Proficiency with engineering software: ETAP, Easypower, PSCAD, Polaris, CDEGS, ASPEN Line Constants, TLW-GEN.

• Experience working on renewable projects required.

• Ability to independently manage workload and complete tasks.

• Strong analytical skills, self-motivated, and able to work under pressure.

• Excellent presentation, verbal, and written communication skills.

• Strong interpersonal skills to build effective relationships with staff, management, clients, and external agencies.

• Must have authorization to work permanently in U.S

Preferred qualifications:

• Experience performing electromagnetic transient (EMT) and switching transient studies, including lightning, switching events, converter-based resource interactions, and protection-related transients.

• Hands-on experience with transient modeling and analysis tools such as PSCAD (or equivalent EMT tools).

• Experience supporting transient studies for renewable energy facilities.

title: Business Development Manager, Japan
description:
法人営業/アカウントエグゼクティブ

当社について

Idealsは、セキュアなビジネスコラボレーション市場において最 高評価を得て顧客中心主義を掲げるグローバルB2B SaaS製 品企業です。世界300,000社以上、200万人以上のユーザー から信頼され、高リスクな業務プロセスや重要な意思決定を、ス トレス軽減・品質向上・時間短縮で実現する支援を提供していま す。

Ideals Virtual Data Room (VDR)：デューデリジェンス、資金 調達、企業報告、ライセンス契約、臨床試験、その他の複雑な取 引のための安全な文書共有・コラボレーションツール。

役職について

日本におけるIdealsの急成長を支えるため、東京のコーポレー ト部門に特化したアカウントエグゼクティブを募集しています。東 京の5名以上の営業チーム（Key Accounts Sales）に参画して いただきます。

エネルギー、製薬、バイオテクノロジー、通信など、多様な業界の 大手企業に対して直接販売を行います。 ノルマを持つ戦略的セラーとして、新規エンタープライズ顧客の 獲得および既存顧客の拡大を通じて収益を成長させます。影響 力のある業界エキスパートとして需要を創出し、6〜9ヶ月に及ぶ 複雑な営業サイクルを推進しながら、深いヒアリング（ディスカバ リー）とコンサルティング型営業により既存ベンダーからのリプレ イスを実現します。

使用技術スタック： HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator、Amplemarket

 

勤務地：丸の内二重橋ビルディング https://share.google/OlRR71fi2tFFW620J (ハイブリッドワーキング/リモートファースト)

※商談の際はクライアント先へ訪問していただきますが、それ以外の通常業務は在宅勤務（リモートワーク）が可能です。

 

なぜIDEALSか？

- 市場をリードする実績：VDR事業において18年以上の実績があり、G2 https://www.g2.com/categories/virtual-data-room?tab=highest_ratedやUpGuard https://www.upguard.com/security-report/ideals-virtual-data-roomで最高評価を獲得。世界のM&A取引の10%以上で弊社プロダクトが活用されており、業界平均（11%）を大きく上回る年平均成長率（CAGR）31%を達成。

- 成熟し信頼の高いセールス組織：RepVue登録15,000社以上の営業組織中、上位10%に評価。英・米で「Great Place To Work® (2026)」に認定。セールスイネーブルメント、RevOps、マーケティングの強力な支援と体系的なオンボーディング環境が整っています。

- 確かな成長軌道：外部資本に頼らない自力経営（ブートストラップ）で黒字成長を維持。今後5年で売上5倍・ユニコーン企業化を目指しています。

主な業務内容

- 新規エンタープライズ顧客（新規ロゴ）の獲得に焦点を当てたパイプラインを主体的に構築・管理する

- 対面およびオンラインでのクライアントミーティング、エグゼクティブ向けプレゼンテーション、製品デモなど、ソリューション形の営業活動を推進する。

- 「ホワイトスペース（未開拓領域）」の分析を維持し、既存顧客基盤内でのアップセルおよびクロスセルに向けた戦略的取り組みを推進する

- 体系的な中長期予測を含め、CRM上で個人の営業活動データを正確に管理・更新する

- 製品開発チームへ適切な顧客フィードバックを提供し、カスタマーサクセス、マーケティング、インバウンド営業チームと連携して収益および顧客満足度を最大化する

募集要項

- B2B営業において4〜7年の明確な達成実績（ノルマ達成実績）があること

- 大手企業（エンタープライズ）向けの中長期または複雑な営業サイクルの推進・管理実績

- 経営幹部（C-Level）への直接提案、および組織内における複数ステークホルダーへのアプローチ（マルチスレッディング）経験

- コンサルティング型営業手法（例：MEDDIC/MEDPIC、SPIN、Challengerなど）に対する明確な理解と実践経験

- 4年制大学卒以上（学士号）

- 卓越したビジネスコミュニケーション能力（エグゼクティブ向けストーリーテリング、現状への課題提起、複雑な契約交渉の実践力）

- 高いAI活用能力、およびCRMを用いた高度なデータ管理・運用スキル

- ネイティブレベルの日本語力

- ビジネスレベルの英語力

優遇条件

- SaaS、金融テクノロジー（FinTech）、または情報セキュリティ分野での経験・バックグラウンド

- エンタープライズM&Aのユースケースおよび企業コンプライアンスワークフローに関する知識・理解

選考プロセス

- 採用担当者とのスクリーニング面談（40分）

- 採用マネージャー質疑応答＆ロープレイ面接（60分）

- コンピテンシー面接（CBI）（60分）

当社が提供する環境

私たちは人材を最も重視しています。そのため、あなたの可能性を最大限に引き出すためのあらゆるリソースとサポートを提供します。

最高の仕事のために

理想的な勤務形態を実現するハイブリッド勤務の柔軟性

在宅勤務環境整備のための予算

コワーキングスペース利用費の補助

追加機器購入のための個人IT予算

最先端技術とAI搭載ツール

成長のために

豊富な講座を提供する「Ideals Academy」へのアクセス

外部研修・能力開発活動への投資

個人開発計画（PDP）作成の指導

専門書籍・定期購読料の補助

講演者・執筆者としての活動支援

社内異動の機会

ウェルビーイングのために

心身の健康をサポートするカスタマイズ型ウェルネスパッケージ

スポーツ競技への資金援助

健康関連有給休暇

年間15営業日の年次有給休暇

追加特典

グローバル拠点での地域交流会予算

充実した社内紹介制度

 

私たちの文化

献身、卓越性、協働、信頼、思いやりは、アイデアルズチームの核心的価値観です。私たちは、これらの価値観を共有する志を同じくする人材を求めています。そうすることで、才能ある人々が安心して能力を最大限に発揮できるチームを創り上げます。

 

詳細はこちら https://ideals.jobs/our-culture/。

 

Idealsは機会均等雇用主です。多様な背景やライフスタイルを持つ人材で構成されています。私たちは多様性を尊重し、あらゆる分野の方々からの応募を歓迎します。性別同一性・表現、性的指向、人種、宗教、年齢、国籍、市民権に基づく従業員や応募者への差別は一切行いません。

title: Controls Engineer
description:

This position can expect to travel to client facilities throughout North America and to our headquarters in Santa Barbara, CA up to 50% of the time.
Ready to revolutionize industrial refrigeration? Crossno & Kaye, Inc. seeks a Control Engineer in Santa Barbara, CA. As a Controls Engineer you'll play a key role in deploying ATLAS, our cloud-based controls platform, that optimizes performance, enhances safety, and drives sustainability. You'll configure, test, and implement advanced control systems that directly impact facility operations, collaborating across teams to deliver cutting-edge solutions that transform our customers' success.
This role will report directly to our Sr Manager of Field Operations and we are looking for this individual to start immediately.
Duties include:

• Owning the creation, implementation, and testing of the facility configuration, including all controls strategies, cause and effects, I/O lists, user permissions, and hardware lists.

• Leading the completion of customer service tickets for various parts of the ATLAS Control System.

• Performing QA Testing with Product/Tech Teams to make sure systems are working properly and able to identify issues with potential solutions.

• Create and error check I/O lists, including ensuring wires are landed properly and I/O points are correctly named and marked.

• Assist in troubleshooting electrical panels and electrical signals.

• Discovering discrepancies during testing and working with the controls team to update the control strategy.

• Learn and use CK’s internal control language to write, document, test, and help deploy control strategies including:

• Safety checks and responses;

• Finite state machines at the equipment level;

• Process control integrating equipment level control.

• Monitor, characterize, and improve performance of deployed controls: Setpoint tracking; Tuning; Response times; Response characteristics.

• Assist in advanced process control and scheduling.

• Contribute to internal control language and software platform feature requests and provide feedback, bug reports, and recommendations to the software team.

• Conduct system evaluation and make appropriate recommendations to repair the control system as needed.

• Has the ability to understand our customer and possesses the passion and drive that the CK team has for the success of Atlas.

• Assist in development of ATLAS technical training for facility maintenance teams that covers basic troubleshooting, hardware replacement and manual operation of systems in the event of critical failure.

Position requires:

• Bachelors Degree in Engineering or related field and 36 months of experience in Industrial automation applications, and Deep knowledge of PLCs, with the ability to independently program in ladder logic;

• Experience with various Control Systems including, but not limited to SCADA or similar.;

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills to be applied in troubleshooting, programming, and potential repair to the facilities current machinery.

Compensation:
The estimated total cash compensation for this role is $155,000-$175,000 , which includes base salary, target bonus (for full-time team members), and applicable field pay. In addition, full-time team members are eligible for equity options-giving you the opportunity to grow alongside the company and share in the long-term success we're building together.
Final compensation is determined by several factors, including prior experience, skills, and alignment with the role. The range above is intended to provide a helpful benchmark, though it may be updated as needed.
Benefits & Perks:

• Competitive salary, travel pay, and equity opportunities

• Health, dental, vision insurance

• 401(k) plan and parental leave

• Untracked PTO and sick days

• Cell phone reimbursements and other perks

title: Staff Software Engineer, AI Platform (US - Remote or Calgary)
description:
Do you want to empower organizations to build smarter compensation strategies while ensuring fair pay for all employees?

Syndio is the leading pay governance and compensation intelligence platform. We help organizations make better pay decisions at every stage of the compensation lifecycle, from leveling and offers to promotions and merit. Our platform gives HR, compensation, and finance leaders the data and decision support they need to govern pay fairly, compliantly, and with confidence. We partner with many of the world’s most recognized and respected enterprises, helping them implement leading-edge compensation solutions with expert guidance and analyzing pay for over 10 million employees across the world.

Join us in our mission to help companies make smarter pay decisions they can trust!

About the Role:
Syndi is Syndio 's AI platform - one shared agent experience (in-product chat, Slack, Teams) serving our product lines, built on syndi-api: an agent runtime owning orchestration, tool calling, memory, RAG, evals, and observability, live in production today. The platform is young (v1 shipped this quarter), moving fast, and designed around a clear operating model: product teams contribute domain content through APIs, evals, and knowledge - the platform owns the experience.
We're hiring a staff-level engineer to take ownership of major runtime surfaces and grow into a technical owner of the platform. This is a high-autonomy role on a small team (3-4 engineers): you'll design, ship, and operate systems end-to-end, and you'll work directly with product-team owners through the platform's contribution seams.
What You'll Work On

• Core runtime surfaces of syndi-api: the agent loop, tool execution and registry, memory, context management (Python, Postgres, Claude on Vertex, GCP).

• The eval system - offline gates and online detector/judge evals written onto production traces - and its growth as product teams adopt it.

• Production operation: observability (Datadog LLM Obs), incident response, the reliability of an agent surface real customers use.

• The platform's contribution seams: reviewing product teams' tool wrappers and evals, evolving the GET /tools registry and drift-detection contract.

• Clarifying, designing, and implementing compliance and legal requirements for Syndi.

What We're Looking For

• 5+ years building production backend systems; deep comfort with Python, relational stores, and cloud infra (we're on GCP/Kubernetes).

• You've built LLM-powered systems in production - an agent loop, tool-calling integration, RAG, or eval infrastructure - and have opinions from the scar tissue.

• You design for operability: legal compliance, tracing, evals, and kill switches are part of the feature, not afterthoughts.

• You can own a technical domain with light supervision: propose direction in writing with clear API specs, take review, ship, and carry the pager for what you shipped.

• Strong written communication - our operating model runs on design docs and PR review across team boundaries.

• Nice to have: experience being the platform side of a platform/product relationship; SSE/streaming systems; compliance-adjacent engineering (data minimization, auditability); prior Staff scope.

Why you'll love it here:

• 💰 Competitive Compensation. For this role our salary is targeted at $205-225k USD or $180-200k CAD per year. Final offer amounts are determined by factors such as experience and expertise.

• 🏆 Syndio Equity. So you can share in Syndio ’s success

• 🏝 Flexible Vacation Policy. We encourage our team to recharge when they need to (up to 20 days PTO in Canada) plus paid sick & safe time, compassion leave, and voting leave.

• 🩺 Medical, Dental, Vision. Syndio pays 90% of employee premiums, and 50% for dependents.

• 🏥 Life Insurance & Disability. Syndio covers the full premium.

• 📍Remote-first in US + Alberta; in Calgary, non-mandatory office available

title: Senior Product Manager, Carrot Ads

Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work-whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop-while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Carrot Ads is one of the fastest-growing parts of Instacart 's Ads business and is central to Instacart 's strategy for expanding its advertising ecosystem beyond its own properties.

title: Principal Consultant | Payments SME
description:
Principal Consultant - Payments SME

Location: Hong Kong (Hybrid) | Practice Area: Banking & Payments | Type: Permanent

Shape the future of payments. Lead transformation. Deliver lasting impact.

The Role

As a Principal Consultant within Capco's Banking & Payments practice, you'll help leading financial institutions design, transform and modernise their payments capabilities. Combining deep payments expertise with strong consulting and technology knowledge, you'll lead complex engagements from discovery through to solution design and delivery.

You'll work closely with senior client stakeholders to define payment strategies, assess current state capabilities, and develop target operating models and technology solutions across domestic and cross-border payment ecosystems. As a trusted advisor, you'll bring industry insight, structured problem solving and strong communication skills to help clients navigate evolving customer expectations, regulatory requirements and industry change.

What You'll Do

• Payments consulting: Lead strategic and transformation initiatives across retail banking payments, helping clients optimise payment processes, operating models and technology capabilities.

• Discovery and solution design: Facilitate workshops, conduct assessments and lead discovery activities to define business requirements, target-state architecture and delivery roadmaps.

• Solution architecture: Design end-to-end payment solutions across domestic and cross-border payment ecosystems, ensuring alignment with business objectives, customer needs and regulatory requirements.

• Client advisory: Act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, providing insights into market trends, emerging technologies and payments innovation.

• Consulting excellence: Develop high-quality presentations, executive papers and client deliverables, translating complex concepts into clear and compelling recommendations.

• Leadership and delivery: Lead multidisciplinary project teams, manage client relationships and support business development efforts across the Banking & Payments practice.

What We're Looking For

• Deep expertise within retail banking payments, supported by strong technology and solution design experience.

• Proven experience leading discovery workshops, requirements gathering activities and solution architecture engagements.

• Strong understanding of domestic and cross-border payment ecosystems, including local regulatory and compliance considerations.

• Experience delivering large-scale payments transformation programmes within financial services.

• Excellent consulting, stakeholder management and executive communication skills, with the ability to develop compelling client presentations and strategic recommendations.

• Strong commercial awareness and the ability to engage effectively with business and technology stakeholders at all levels.

• Experience working with leading financial institutions in Hong Kong and the wider Asia-Pacific region.

Why Join Capco

• Advise leading banks on some of the region's most strategic payments transformation programmes.

• Work in a collaborative, flat and entrepreneurial consulting culture.

• Access continuous learning, leadership development and industry certifications.

• Influence the future of payments, digital banking and financial services innovation.

• Help shape the growth of Capco's Banking & Payments practice across Asia.

Inclusion at Capco

We're committed to making our recruitment process accessible and straightforward for everyone. If you need any adjustments at any stage, just let us know and we'll be happy to help. We value each person's unique perspective and contribution. At Capco, we believe that being yourself is your greatest strength. Our #BeYourselfAtWork culture encourages individuality and collaboration, a mindset that shapes how we work with clients and each other every day.

Founded in 2017, Wayve is the leading developer of Embodied AI technology.  Our advanced AI software and foundation models enable vehicles to perceive, understand, and navigate any complex environment, enhancing the usability and safety of automated driving systems.

Our vision is to create autonomy that propels the world forward.  Our intelligent, mapless, and hardware-agnostic AI products are designed for automakers, accelerating the transition from assisted to automated driving. 

In our fast-paced environment big problems ignite us-we embrace uncertainty, leaning into complex challenges to unlock groundbreaking solutions. We aim high and stay humble in our pursuit of excellence, constantly learning and evolving as we pave the way for a smarter, safer future.

Make Wayve the experience that defines your career!  

The role

As a DevOps CI/CD Engineer, you’ll work on the build and CI/CD systems that enable Wayve’s engineering teams to develop, test, and release software efficiently and reliably.

You’ll help make our pipelines faster, more scalable, more secure, and easier for engineers to use. You’ll work closely with software engineers across the business to understand workflow pain points, troubleshoot complex build and pipeline issues, and deliver infrastructure and tooling improvements that have a direct impact on engineering productivity.

• Contribute to the evolution of Wayve’s CI/CD architecture, security, and operational practices as engineering workloads scale.

• Partner with engineering teams to improve developer experience and support efficient software delivery.

Essential skills

• 3+ years of experience in DevOps, build engineering, CI/CD, developer infrastructure, platform engineering, or a related engineering role.

• Hands-on experience building, maintaining, or significantly improving CI/CD pipelines and automation systems.

• Experience with CI/CD platforms such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Buildkite, Azure DevOps, or similar.

• Experience with build tooling and concepts such as dependency management, caching, incremental builds, artifact management, and reproducible builds.

• Strong experience working with Linux, Git, and shell scripting. Programming or scripting experience using Python, Bash, Go, or similar.

• Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, especially in complex build, pipeline, or infrastructure environments.

• A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively with engineering teams to improve developer workflows.

Desirable skills

• Experience operating CI infrastructure at scale, including runners, agents, distributed build systems, or self-hosted CI environments.

• Experience with cloud infrastructure, containers, Kubernetes, or infrastructure-as-code.

If you are driven to enhance the US healthcare system, MCG is eager to have you join our team. As Senior Product Manager, Data Platform, you will own product direction for data platform capabilities that make healthcare data usable across payer, provider, and partner environments.
This role focuses on the product foundations behind trusted data use: ingestion, mapping, normalization, validation, permissions, auditability, and delivery.
The Senior Product Manager turns ambiguous healthcare data problems into clear, buildable requirements. • Define and execute the data product strategy and roadmap aligned with company objectives, customer needs, and data-driven growth opportunities.

• Develop business cases and investment recommendations for new platform capabilities, data services, and strategic enhancements that improve scalability, interoperability, and customer value.

• Lead cross-functional teams to deliver scalable data products and insights solutions.

• Translate business requirements into data product capabilities, prioritizing initiatives that drive measurable business outcomes.

• Partner with engineering and analytics teams to develop, launch, and optimize data platforms, reporting solutions, and advanced analytics products.

• Conduct market research, customer discovery, and competitive analysis to identify emerging data opportunities and inform product investments.

• Define and monitor KPIs for data products, leveraging analytics to measure performance, user adoption, business impact, and continuous improvement opportunities.

• Evaluate new data monetization opportunities, develop business cases, and assess financial impact for data-driven offerings and partnerships.

• Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Partner teams to understand customer needs and uncover opportunities for data-enabled solutions.

• Develop data product positioning, value propositions, and go-to-market strategies to drive adoption and revenue growth.

• Partner directly with customers and strategic accounts to gather requirements, validate product-market fit, and identify opportunities for innovation.

• Serve as the voice of the customer and business stakeholder, ensuring data products deliver actionable insights, usability, trust, and measurable value.

title: Telesales Executive - Hindi
description:
About Lokal :
In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online. This spark became Lokal . Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.
Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:
to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.
We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

• Edutainment & Skill Learning - practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)

• Matrimonial Matchmaking - hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search ( Lokal Matrimony)

• Agri Consulting - farmer-first advisory in local languages (Agri Lokal )

• Local Jobs - blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home ( Lokal Jobs)

• Social & Community - Place to find & post social updates ( Lokal app)

• Emotional Well-being & Peer Support - safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)

• Astrology & Guidance - instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (Astro Lokal )

• Advisory Services - early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.
This is the story new teammates walk into:
a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre - access changes lives.
We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.
We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital.
Role Overview :
We are looking for a driven Telesales Executive (Tamil-speaking) to support Lokal App’s growth by engaging potential users through outbound calls and converting leads into customers. • Conduct outbound calls to prospective clients and effectively promote Lokal App's services.

• Engage with users to identify their needs and create tailored solutions that fit their requirements.

• Maintain accurate records of calls, interactions, and leads in the CRM system.

• Follow up on leads and manage the sales process from initial contact through to closing.

• Collaborate with the marketing team to leverage campaigns and enhance sales efforts.

• Provide feedback on customer interactions and market trends to help shape future strategies.

• Achieve monthly sales targets and contribute to the overall growth of Lokal App.

Requirements

• Fluency in Hindi and a good command of English .

• Previous experience in telesales or sales roles is preferred.

• Excellent verbal communication and persuasive skills.

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Familiarity with CRM software

Hospitals run on three things: their people, their beds, and their supplies… and all are still managed with spreadsheets, phone calls, and gut instinct. Vitalize is building the system that runs it all intelligently, starting with labor - the biggest cost (nearly 60% of a hospital’s P&L) and the hardest operational problem.

We're building the labor and capacity operating system for health systems - forecasting demand, matching the right staff to it automatically, and coordinating patients across the hospital.

The impact is real: we save hospitals millions in unnecessary labor spend, give clinical leaders back 10-20 hours every week, and are often the reason staff and leaders stay. This isn't a nice-to-have: our customers pay 5-15x more than legacy incumbents because Vitalize is mission-critical software their hospitals rely on every single minute.

We've raised over $32M from top investors, and even our own customers.

title: Senior Clinical Trial Manager - Oncology
description:
Who we are
We’re a global, midsize CRO that pushes boundaries, innovates and invents because the path to a cure for the world’s most persistent diseases is not paved by those who play it safe. It is built by those who take pioneering, creative approaches and implement them with quality and excellence.
We are Worldwide Clinical Trials , and we are a global team of over 3,500+ experts, bright thinkers, dreamers and doers and, together, we are changing the way the world experiences CROs - in the best possible way.
Our mission is to work with passion and purpose every day to improve lives and we are looking for others who value this same pursuit.
Why Worldwide
We believe everyone plays an important role in making a world of difference for patients and their caregivers. From our hands-on, accessible leaders, to our cohesive and supportive teams, we are committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed. We prioritize cultivating a diverse and inclusive environment that continues to promote collaboration and creativity. We are proud to be a workplace where people thrive by being themselves and are inspired to do their best work every day. Join us!
n

What Clinical Operations Site Management does at Worldwide

Clinical Trial Managers (CTMs) and Clinical Research Associates (CRAs) play a vital role in ensuring our clinical research programs are executed with the quality and excellence our sponsors expect and the care and passion patients deserve.

These roles are the backbone of every strong CRO, helping drive breakthrough scientific research and playing a lead role in every clinical trial. All CROs will promise you growth, opportunity, and maybe even a challenge. But we offer more than that. We offer an uncommon experience - one you can’t get anywhere else, with a team unlike anyone else.

At Worldwide, we balance fun with the serious business of changing lives. We have a values-driven culture that is built from the ground up. We empower our team members to treat every trial like a patient’s life depends on it - because it does. Our leaders are in the trenches with you, committed to advancing science and moving mountains for our customers.

What you will do

• Provide leadership and direction to clinical site management team members from study start through to closure

• Serve as Site Management’s primary point of contact and representative for clinical monitoring and site activities within the project, including, but not limited to

• Primary Sponsor Contact

• Manage monitoring deliverables to achieve the study budget and identify out-of-scope activities

What you will bring to the role

• Excellent interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills in English

• Ability to lead and motivate a team remotely

• Demonstrate initiative and problem-solving skills by offering solutions when obstacles are identified

• Strong customer focus, ability to interact professionally with a sponsor contact

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, CTMS, and EDC Systems

Your experience

• Bachelor’s Degree or a Nursing Degree required

• 2+ years’ experience as a Clinical Trial Manager, Clinical Operations Leader, Lead CRA, or equivalent role

• 4+ years’ experience as a Clinical Research Associate

• Oncology experience is required

• Willingness to travel up to 30%

At Worldwide Clinical Trials , we are committed to fostering an inclusive and equitable workplace by providing transparent compensation.

The salary range for this position is annually (For hourly paid positions, the stated salary range reflects hourly rates):

United States of America - $112,000.00 - $222,000.00 The salary range provided is intended to give candidates an understanding of potential earnings. Compensation will fall within the provided range, and it not a guarantee of exact salary.
